def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]

lemma myRev_append (xs ys : List α) : myRev (xs ++ ys) = myRev ys ++ myRev xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs' =>
    simp [myRev, List.append_assoc]
    rw [myRev_append]
    rw [List.append_assoc]

lemma myRev_empty (xs : List α) : myRev [] ++ xs = xs := by
  simp

theorem myRev_myRev (xs : List α) : myRev (myRev xs) = xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs' =>
    simp [myRev, List.append_assoc] at *
    have h₁ : myRev ([] ++ [x]) = [x] := by simp [myRev_append]
    have h₂ : myRev (myRev xs') = xs' := myRev_myRev xs'
    simp [myRev_append, h₁, h₂]
